title: Gca Bay Area Ras Garba - Oct 24th By Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team - Sharda Musical Group
description: Experience the Vibrancy of Gujarati Culture at GCA Bay Area Ras Garba
organizer: Gujarati Cultural Associaton Of Bay Area
long_description:
Experience the Vibrancy of Gujarati Culture at GCA Bay Area Ras Garba
Immerse yourself in the heart-throbbing rhythm of the Gujarati folk dance at the GCA Bay Area Ras Garba on the 24th of October, 2026. Organized by the Gujarati Cultural Association of the Bay Area, this event promises a night of energetic dance, traditional music, and multilingual camaraderie. Celebrate Navratri/Dandiya with the spectacular show put together by the talented Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team - Sharda Musical Group. This is a unique opportunity to experience the vibrant Gujarati culture firsthand.
Meet the Maestros: Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team - Sharda Musical Group
While no specific artist is highlighted for this event, the Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team - Sharda Musical Group is renowned for their energetic performances and infectious rhythms. Their music is a brilliant fusion of traditional and contemporary beats that captivate audiences and keep the dance floor alive. Known for their dynamism and creativity, the team never fails to deliver a memorable performance.
Join Us at the Historic Washington High School
The event will take place at the iconic Washington High School, located at 38442 Boulevard, Fremont, CA, United States. Renowned for its safety and accessibility, the venue offers ample parking spaces for attendees. While you're in Fremont, don't forget to check out some of the nearby Indian restaurants for a taste of desi cuisine. The city is a hub of cultural diversity, making it the perfect location for this celebration of Gujarati tradition.
Secure Your Spot: Ticket Information
Tickets are now available for purchase. General admission for the event is priced at $25.00. However, if you're planning to attend with a group of 8 or more, you can take advantage of our group discount and secure tickets at $23.00 each. Don't miss this opportunity to be part of a spectacular cultural celebration. Book your tickets today!
